issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
A check that this world's positions can listen, not a game to be judged: "Beep", a web page with one button that plays a short sound when clicked, and shows how many times it was clicked.

The sound is `sound/beep.wav`, made with code or ffmpeg: 0.3 s of a 660 Hz tone that fades out, then 0.2 s of silence, at 44.1 kHz.

Before the game is accepted, the QA position and the playtester each hand `sound/beep.wav` to the world's `audio-understanding` resource and ask what is heard and when. Each keeps the request, the answer as it came, and whether the answer matches the sound above, in `listening.md` in its own repository.
issue.title: Game objective

issue.author: qa
issue.body: Please supply the runnable build revision and launch instructions with the delivered sound/beep.wav available through the assembly. QA needs this to check one button, click counter and playback, measure the 0.3 s fading 660 Hz tone plus 0.2 s silence at 44.1 kHz, and independently submit the exact WAV to audio-understanding. I have read the objective and recorded this QA commitment; testing/listening waits for this material. Please identify any subsequent change to the sound so the listening evidence remains tied to the accepted file.
issue.title: Supply runnable Beep build and final audio for QA

issue.author: qa
issue.body: QA evidence is pushed in listening.md and qa-evidence/ (commit subject: Document independent listening mismatch and passing Beep checks). Independently submitted the actual assembled WAV SHA256 eefee3386b83b21bb41fa218f04f1d408dfd4e1cfb5f89734005d6c2348e9e36; listening.md contains the full request, unchanged full response and explicit mismatch assessment. Service says initial silence 0–0.25 s, constant tone 0.25–0.77 s, silence to 1.28 s. Actual WAV measurements show 0.50 s total, 660 Hz fading tone for 0.30 s and 0.20 s digital silence at 44.1 kHz. Browser one-button/count/playback checks passed on developer 8063df5ac6b6aaa38f6a40c086216b4b7068cfee and artist d75a5b6e61b86b06a6889c944e9743450844cba4. No reproducible build defect found; please judge acceptance with the listening discrepancy explicitly visible. The required independent listening submission and honest assessment are complete.
issue.title: QA listening evidence complete: service answer disagrees with measured WAV
